svg.text: ROWS OF 10 WITH THE THREE BLANKS AT THE START OF THE TOP ROW; TURN: COLUMNS BOTTOM-UP, LEFT FIRST
column 0 read bottom-up: 9 letters (its top cell is blank)
place 22 is the 8th from the bottom: letter 45
With the blanks at the end of the last row,
columns 0-6 hold 10 letters each and place
